title: CharXiv: Charting Gaps in Realistic Chart Understanding in Multimodal LLMs
authors_zh: Zirui Wang 等（Princeton Language and Intelligence, Princeton University、University of Wisconsin, Madison、The University of Hong Kong）

one_line: CharXiv exposes chart understanding from arXiv papers as an auditable evaluation surface.
CharXiv 把取自 arXiv 论文的图表理解做成可审计的评测面。
why: Realistic paper-chart surface with human-verified reasoning questions.
inclusion_reason: Realistic paper-chart surface with human-verified reasoning questions.

title: Problem
问题
html: CharXiv asks whether multimodal LLMs really understand realistic scientific charts, using the June 2024 arXiv paper and NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks release as the primary source. The gap is that many chart benchmarks use synthetic or simplified figures, so scores can overstate performance on charts found in papers. The data object is a chart image from an arXiv paper plus a human-curated question, answer, and metadata for descriptive or reasoning evaluation. The card belongs in the atlas as an evaluation surface, not as a training recipe or chart-generation dataset. Its value is the explicit feedback contract: compare the model answer against verified reference answers with the official evaluator and keep the public split, prompt, and judge version pinned.

CharXiv 关注的是多模态模型能否读懂真实论文里的科学图表，主来源是 2024 年 6 月 arXiv 论文和 NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks 版本。它要补的缺口不是再造一批模板图，而是把 arXiv 论文中的自然图表变成可评分问答。一个样本包含图表图片、人工整理的问题、参考答案，以及描述类或推理类任务标记。它应作为评测面收录，不应被当成训练配方或图表生成数据。复用时必须固定公开 split、prompt、官方 evaluator/GPT-4o judge 版本和答案规范。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The contribution is a human-verified benchmark of 2,323 realistic charts from arXiv papers with two answer-level tasks: descriptive chart reading and reasoning over chart content. The mechanism changes the baseline from clean synthetic chart QA to paper-chart QA with curated questions and verified answers. The feedback contract is answer-level accuracy under the released evaluation pipeline, including GPT-4o-based grading for open responses. Closest comparisons are prior chart QA suites and stress tests that use simpler chart distributions. The direction label is realistic multimodal evaluation surface with contamination and judge-version risk.

核心贡献是把 2,323 个来自 arXiv 论文的真实图表整理成人工核验的问答基准，任务分为基础图表描述和跨视觉元素推理。它相对旧基准的变化在于数据分布：不再主要依赖干净模板图，而是面向论文图中的坐标、图例、子图、趋势和数值关系。反馈契约是官方评测流程下的 answer-level accuracy，其中开放式回答依赖 GPT-4o 风格的语义判分。最近对比对象是 ChartQA 等较规则图表问答集和作者展示的 chart/question stress tests。方向标签是 realistic multimodal evaluation surface。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Inputs: scientific chart images selected from arXiv papers, plus curated natural-language questions and reference answers.
  2. Pipeline: authors handpick charts, write or curate descriptive and reasoning questions, verify answers, and release validation/test files with chart assets and metadata.
  3. Outputs: benchmark records for model prompting, model answers, and per-question correctness under the official evaluator.
  4. Feedback: the decisive signal is answer-level agreement with the verified answer, implemented through the released evaluation scripts and GPT-4o grading for non-exact responses.
  5. Reproducibility: pin the data split, image files, prompt template, evaluator code, GPT-4o model/date if used, and any leaderboard snapshot. The benchmark is evaluation-only; scores do not define a reward model without a separate audit.

1. 输入：从 arXiv 论文中选出的科学图表图片，以及人工整理的问题和参考答案。
  2. 流程：作者筛选图表，构造描述类和推理类问题，核验答案，并发布 validation/test 数据、图片和元数据。
  3. 输出：可用于提示模型的 benchmark record、模型回答和逐题正确性。
  4. 反馈：通过官方 evaluator 判断回答是否与参考答案一致；非严格字符串匹配场景使用 GPT-4o 式语义判分。
  5. 复现边界：必须固定 split、图片文件、prompt 模板、评测代码、GPT-4o 判分模型/日期和 leaderboard 快照。它是 evaluation-only 资源，不能直接等同于训练 reward。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper reports 2,323 natural and diverse charts and a large gap between current MLLMs and humans: GPT-4o is reported at 47.1% accuracy, the strongest open-source model cited at 29.2%, and human performance at 80.5%. The row-level evidence is the verified reference answer for each chart question and the evaluator verdict on a submitted answer. The official GitHub, project page, Hugging Face dataset, and OpenReview/NeurIPS record support the release status. Evidence is bounded by the public benchmark version, prompt format, judge model, and the fact that aggregate accuracy does not certify that an individual chart interpretation is semantically faithful beyond the answer key.

论文报告了 2,323 个自然且多样的论文图表，并给出现有多模态模型与人类的明显差距：GPT-4o 为 47.1% accuracy，作者引用的最强开源模型为 29.2%，人类为 80.5%。逐样本证据不是总分，而是每个图表问题的核验答案和 evaluator 对模型回答的判定。官方 GitHub、项目页、Hugging Face 数据集和 OpenReview/NeurIPS 记录支撑其公开发布状态。证据边界包括 public benchmark 版本、prompt、judge 模型，以及总分不能自动证明每个图表解释都语义完整。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior chart QA benchmarks often use simplified chart styles, template-like questions, or distributions that allow brittle shortcuts. CharXiv changes the object to real scientific figures and separates basic descriptive reading from harder reasoning. The direction signal is that multimodal reasoning evaluation must carry source-image provenance and answer-verification metadata, not just a final score. The quality signal is human selection and answer verification plus a public evaluator. What is not new: image QA, chart QA, and LLM-as-judge scoring already exist. Before reuse, inspect dataset license, chart-paper provenance, split exposure, evaluator prompts, and whether public examples have entered model training corpora.

已有图表问答常偏向简化样式、模板问题或可被捷径利用的分布；CharXiv 的新意在于把对象换成真实科学论文图表，并区分基础读图和复杂推理。方向信号是：多模态推理评测需要保留图表来源、问题类型、答案核验和判分器版本，而不只是排行榜总分。质量信号来自人工筛选、答案核验和公开 evaluator。它并不发明图像问答、图表问答或 LLM-as-judge。复用前要查 license、图表论文 provenance、公开 split 暴露、判分 prompt，以及数据是否污染后续模型训练。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Correctness is relative to the provided question, reference answer, and evaluator, not to a complete semantic audit of the source paper or chart. GPT-4o grading can drift with model version, prompt, and policy changes. Public chart images and answers create contamination risk for future MLLMs. The benchmark does not measure chart generation, paper-level scientific validity, or whether a model can cite the original paper. License and redistribution terms should be checked at the artifact level before repackaging charts.
正确性只相对于给定问题、参考答案和 evaluator 成立，不等于完整审计原论文或图表语义。GPT-4o 判分会受模型版本、prompt 和服务策略变化影响。公开图表、问题和答案会带来未来模型训练污染。它不评测图表生成、论文科学结论是否成立，也不要求模型能追溯原论文。若要再分发图片或数据，必须单独检查 artifact license 和图表来源授权。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use CharXiv as a schema for realistic multimodal benchmark records: image provenance, question type, reference answer, evaluator verdict, and judge configuration should travel with each instance. It is useful for comparing chart-reading prompts, visual reasoning models, and benchmark-contamination defenses. For atlas reuse, preserve chart source, split, prompt, model answer, evaluator result, and evaluator version/date. Do not collapse descriptive and reasoning subsets when diagnosing failures.

CharXiv 可作为真实多模态评测记录的 schema 参考：每条样本都应保留图片来源、问题类型、参考答案、判分结果和 judge 配置。它适合比较读图 prompt、视觉推理模型和污染防护策略。纳入 atlas 时应保留 chart source、split、prompt、模型回答、evaluator verdict、evaluator 版本/日期。分析失败时不要把描述类和推理类混成一个标签。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Keep three layers separate: chart-image realism, question-answer correctness, and LLM-judge reliability. Read the dataset construction and evaluation sections before comparing leaderboard rows. Aggregate accuracy is not a row-level certificate; the reusable object is the chart-question-answer-evaluator tuple.
阅读时分清三层：图表是否真实、问答答案是否正确、LLM judge 是否可靠。比较排行榜前先看数据构造和评测协议。总 accuracy 不是逐题证书；真正可复用的对象是 chart-question-answer-evaluator 组合。
